  cardMarketContent = '## The Avengers: Where Card Collecting Became an Event

The Avengers (2012) wasn''t just the biggest superhero movie ever made at the time — it was a watershed moment for Marvel card collecting. With six heroes, a beloved villain, and $1.5 billion in box office receipts, the demand for Avengers-related cards exploded overnight.

### Key Sets

The **2012 Upper Deck Avengers Assemble** trading card set captured the excitement of the film with extensive autograph and memorabilia cards. This set features the first group shots of the assembled team and includes rare multi-signed cards that are among the most valuable in the hobby.

### Market Trends

Avengers team cards and multi-hero inserts from this era have appreciated significantly. The "Big 3" (Iron Man, Captain America, Thor) autograph cards from Avengers sets command the highest premiums. Mark Ruffalo''s first appearance as Hulk also created new collecting opportunities, as did Jeremy Renner''s expanded Hawkeye role. Loki cards from this set are particularly valuable given Tom Hiddleston''s star-making performance.',
  keyCards = '- **2012 Upper Deck Avengers Assemble Multi-Signed Card** — Multiple cast autographs on one card ($5,000+)
- **Robert Downey Jr. Avengers Autograph** — The anchor of the team, always in demand ($4,000+)
- **Mark Ruffalo as Hulk First Auto** — His MCU debut makes this card historically significant ($1,500+)
- **Tom Hiddleston as Loki Autograph** — Star-making villain performance ($2,500+)
- **2012 Upper Deck Avengers Sketch Cards** — Original 1/1 team artwork by top artists
- **Jeremy Renner as Hawkeye Costume Card** — Screen-worn memorabilia from the Battle of New York',
  content = '## Earth''s Mightiest Heroes, Assembled

The Avengers was the culmination of an unprecedented experiment in cinema. Four years of individual hero films — Iron Man, The Incredible Hulk, Iron Man 2, Thor, and Captain America — all building toward one massive crossover event. Nothing like it had ever been attempted in film history, and the result was a $1.5 billion phenomenon that changed Hollywood forever.

Joss Whedon''s script accomplished the impossible: giving each hero meaningful screen time while building toward a climactic battle that still holds up as one of the greatest action sequences ever filmed.

## The Legacy

- **Third Highest-Grossing Film of All Time (at release)** — $1.519 billion worldwide proved the shared universe model worked
- **Changed Hollywood Forever** — Every studio attempted their own shared universe after this film''s success
- **The Battle of New York** — Referenced in nearly every MCU project since, it became the universe''s defining event
- **Proved the Team-Up Model** — Showed audiences would follow multiple heroes across separate franchises
- **Hulk Smash** — Mark Ruffalo''s Hulk became an instant fan favorite, particularly the Loki smash scene

## Fun Facts

- The famous shawarma post-credits scene was filmed the night of the world premiere
- The rotating shot of all six Avengers assembling was done practically with the actors on a rotating platform
- Robert Downey Jr. hid snacks around the set and was actually eating them in scenes — the blueberry scene was improvised
- The "Puny God" scene (Hulk vs. Loki) was not in the original script and was added during reshoots
- The film broke the opening weekend record with $207 million, a record that stood until 2015

## Viewing Context

The Avengers is the **sixth and final film** of MCU Phase 1. It brings together all the heroes introduced in the previous five films for the first time. The post-credits scene introduces Thanos, setting up the overarching villain for the next decade of MCU storytelling.',
  metaDescription = 'The Avengers (2012) MCU guide — $1.5B box office, full cast breakdown, trading card market analysis with autograph values, and collector tips for Earth''s Mightiest Heroes.',
  keywords = 'The Avengers 2012, MCU Phase 1, Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, Hulk, Black Widow, Hawkeye, Loki, trading cards, Marvel cards, box office, billion dollar',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Topps Marvel Avengers cards',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Is The Avengers (2012) on Disney+?","answer":"Yes, The Avengers (2012) is available on Disney+ as part of the complete MCU collection. It is the sixth and final film of Phase 1, bringing together all previously introduced heroes."},{"question":"How much did The Avengers (2012) make at the box office?","answer":"The Avengers grossed $1.519 billion worldwide against a $220 million budget, making it the third highest-grossing film of all time at release. It earned $207 million on its opening weekend, setting a new record."},{"question":"Who are all the Avengers in the 2012 movie?","answer":"The original six Avengers are: Iron Man (Robert Downey Jr.), Captain America (Chris Evans), Thor (Chris Hemsworth), Hulk (Mark Ruffalo), Black Widow (Scarlett Johansson), and Hawkeye (Jeremy Renner). They are assembled by Nick Fury (Samuel L. Jackson) to fight Loki (Tom Hiddleston)."},{"question":"What Avengers trading cards are worth the most?","answer":"The most valuable include multi-signed cast cards ($5,000+), Robert Downey Jr. autographs ($4,000+), Tom Hiddleston as Loki autos ($2,500+), and Mark Ruffalo first Hulk appearance autos ($1,500+). Team cards and Battle of New York inserts are also highly sought after."},{"question":"What order should I watch the MCU before The Avengers?","answer":"Watch in release order: Iron Man (2008), The Incredible Hulk (2008), Iron Man 2 (2010), Thor (2011), Captain America: The First Avenger (2011), then The Avengers (2012). Each film introduces characters and plot elements that pay off in the team-up."}]',
  status = 'published',
  updatedAt = NOW()
WHERE slug = 'the-avengers-2012'
